scenes.name: Metal industrial y post-industrial
scenes.author: Piero Scaruffi
scenes.desc: Uno de los logros clave de finales de los ochenta: la fusión de música industrial con hard rock y heavy metal, iniciada por los suizos Young Gods (samples de guitarras metálicas) y KMFDM. Chicago la completa: Ministry de Al Jourgensen (The Land Of Rape And Honey, «Jesus Built My Hot Rod»), Revolting Cocks, Pigface de Martin Atkins y, de ahí, Nine Inch Nails de Trent Reznor, que cambia el destino del industrial (Pretty Hate Machine, The Downward Spiral). El post-industrial: Neurosis, Steel Pole Bath Tub, Cop Shoot Cop, Missing Foundation, Pain Teens, Godflesh de Justin Broadrick, y los proyectos de Jello Biafra (Lard, Tumor Circus).

podcast.title: 1979 San Francisco Mayoral Campaign
podcast.body: In 1979, Jello Biafra, the singer for the Dead Kennedys, ran for mayor of San Francisco. His campaign was a political statement, and he finished fourth out of ten candidates. One of his notable campaign promises was to mandate that all city politicians wear clown suits, reflecting his anti-establishment and provocative style. "For example, in 1979, Singer Jello Biafra ran for mayor of San Francisco."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Anti-Censorship Activism
podcast.body: Beyond his musical career and political aspirations, Jello Biafra also became a powerful public speaker, known for his ongoing activism and railing against censorship. "And also to become a very powerful public speaker who continues to rail against censorship."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Political Activism
podcast.body: Jello Biafra, the leader of San Francisco's Dead Kennedys, was known for his ultra-political stance. He later became involved in various anti-establishment causes, including censorship, and once ran for mayor of San Francisco, finishing fourth. "They were led by the ultra-political Jello Biafra, who would later take on all sorts of anti-establishment causes, including censorship."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Post-Punk Explosion Part 7: All the rest

podcast.title: Political Career
podcast.body: Jello Biafra, the singer for the Dead Kennedys, later ran for mayor of San Francisco, finishing fourth in the election. "The dead Kennedys featuring singer Jello Biopro, who would later run for mayor of San Francisco he finished fourth."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Roadie for The Ravers, Co-founded Dead Kennedys
podcast.body: Jello Biafra worked as a roadie for a band called The Ravers. Following this experience, he and East Bay Ray collaborated to form the iconic punk band Dead Kennedys. "Jello Biapro roadied for a band called the Ravers before he and East Bay Rae formed the dead Kennedys."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
